rows.Final behavior: Owner or delegated administrator enters service awards and operating facts once. HR and supervisors maintain staff/client details.
rows.Backend / mapping: Effective-dated agency, site, staff, client, service authorization, relationship and assignment entities. Reuse existing records.
rows.User experience: Ask relevant follow-up questions only; no checklist of all SOW obligations.
rows.Acceptance test: Changing one client ABI fact updates only assigned staff requirements.

rows.Final behavior: General obligations + awarded code obligations + relevant duties/client/site conditions.
rows.Backend / mapping: Typed boolean/enum/date/number predicates with ALL, ANY, NOT, EXISTS, COUNT and date operators; unknown result opens a missing-information issue.
rows.User experience: Show Why this applies, source clause and specific triggering fact.
rows.Acceptance test: Office title alone neither exempts all general staff training nor adds SEI training.

rows.Final behavior: Retain whole SOW, including definitions, restrictions, outcomes and historical provisions.
rows.Backend / mapping: Immutable source version/hash; rule-source many-to-many links; draft > reviewed > published > superseded. Explicit approval actor/date.
rows.User experience: Admin sees only changes affecting the agency.
rows.Acceptance test: New rule version does not rewrite prior service-date compliance.

rows.Final behavior: Create one actionable assignment per applicable subject and period/event.
rows.Backend / mapping: Unique key tenant + requirement version + subject + period/event. Durable jobs, retry and reconciliation. Coverage links allow equivalent evidence reuse.
rows.User experience: My tasks has one card per meaningful obligation, not one card per clause or topic.
rows.Acceptance test: Replaying a hire event three times creates one orientation assignment.

rows.Final behavior: Checklist fields and curriculum topics belong to a parent form/course.
rows.Backend / mapping: Keep clause IDs; split multiple inline subitems into atomic field/topic definitions; preserve ALL/ANY and conditional branches.
rows.User experience: One form with only relevant fields.
rows.Acceptance test: Missing one mandatory topic prevents completion of an ALL group.

rows.Final behavior: Offer Do here, Upload proof, or Open official system only where the rule permits.
rows.Backend / mapping: Allowed methods are a set per requirement version; default handling label is not proof of equivalency.
rows.User experience: One card offers the permitted buttons; an upload is not automatically accepted.
rows.Acceptance test: A generic quiz cannot replace an official DSPD course or external CPR credential.

rows.Final behavior: Platform courses can cover approved internal content, with verifiable successful completion.
rows.Backend / mapping: Course version, trainer qualifications, topic map, assessment criteria, attempts, completion date and staff identity; no invented SOW pass score.
rows.User experience: Complete course or submit equivalent accepted proof.
rows.Acceptance test: Orientation completion requires all applicable topics and person-specific instruction.

rows.Final behavior: Draft, approve, publish and collect required signatures/acknowledgments.
rows.Backend / mapping: Template version and signed immutable snapshot; author, approver, signer, timestamp, purpose and amendment chain.
rows.User experience: Transportation policy can be created here; affected drivers receive acknowledgment only when required or agency policy specifies.
rows.Acceptance test: Editing a published policy creates a new version and does not change prior signed evidence.

rows.Final behavior: One accepted record may satisfy several matching requirements.
rows.Backend / mapping: Evidence-to-requirement links check subject, issuer, scope, coverage, dates and version. No cross-tenant reuse.
rows.User experience: Upload once; see exactly what it satisfies and what remains.
rows.Acceptance test: One certificate with insufficient topic coverage does not complete the entire orientation.

rows.Final behavior: Legal deadline and reminder schedule are separate.
rows.Backend / mapping: Due-date anchor + offset + calendar/business-day type + timezone + holiday calendar; certificate expiry, employment year and plan year are distinct.
rows.User experience: Upcoming work appears before expiry; overdue reason is explicit.
rows.Acceptance test: Early completion of annual hours does not shift the next employment-year deadline.

rows.Final behavior: Automatically remind and escalate according to agency configuration.
rows.Backend / mapping: Suggested 30/14/7/1-day reminders are product defaults, not SOW mandates; deduplicate notifications and resolve on verified completion.
rows.User experience: Staff get a short daily digest; admin sees exceptions and review queue.
rows.Acceptance test: A pending review produces a reviewer reminder, not repeated upload demands to staff.

rows.Final behavior: Not started, in progress, submitted, needs correction, accepted, expired and superseded.
rows.Backend / mapping: Separate applicability, evidence status, deadline status and readiness. Not applicable requires reason/evidence; unknown cannot be compliant.
rows.User experience: Plain labels: Do now, Waiting for review, Needs correction, Complete, Expires soon.
rows.Acceptance test: Uploading a file moves to submitted; only validated acceptance changes compliance.

rows.Final behavior: Select client, actual service code and service date; open the matching note.
rows.Backend / mapping: Versioned code-to-template mapping: general 1.10(7) fields overridden only by explicit code rules; additional EVV/timesheet data remain separate.
rows.User experience: Auto-fill known facts; staff enter actual support, observations and required plan fields.
rows.Acceptance test: A code with a five-field daily note does not silently delete separate EVV or employment timesheet requirements.

rows.Final behavior: Evaluate each claim/service using rules effective on the service date.
rows.Backend / mapping: Authorization 1056, units, service code, qualified staff, documentation, overlap restrictions, exceptions, ratios and conditional EVV. Code + unit type drive calculation.
rows.User experience: Billing view explains each issue and links to the exact fix; no global red status that blocks unrelated services.
rows.Acceptance test: Expired CPR affects applicable future work; unrelated agency policy acknowledgment does not automatically block every claim.

rows.Final behavior: Use hard blocks only for approved explicit prerequisites/prohibitions.
rows.Backend / mapping: Separate source-mandated block, review hold and agency-policy warning; reversible resolution, authority evidence and audit. Draft rules may be simulated but cannot silently reject claims.
rows.User experience: Show rule, affected person/code/date and permitted resolution.
rows.Acceptance test: An unapproved interpretation creates a review issue, not an automatic denial.

rows.Final behavior: Prepare and track official submissions; local completion is not external submission.
rows.Backend / mapping: Destination + required format + submission receipt/status + retry. Use only supported authorized integrations.
rows.User experience: Open UPI/official site, then attach receipt or receive verified integration status.
rows.Acceptance test: SEI monthly data entered in UPI cannot be satisfied solely by uploading a local PDF.

rows.Final behavior: Import from authorized issuer/LMS API or staff-approved mailbox where supported.
rows.Backend / mapping: Integration account, consent/scope, webhook/poll checkpoint, raw receipt, identity matching, duplicate hash and review queue.
rows.User experience: Staff upload remains available when no integration exists.
rows.Acceptance test: No API or issuer access means no claim that certificates are automatically retrieved.

rows.Final behavior: Extract certificate fields, suggest mappings, draft notes from actual recorded facts and identify possible rule changes.
rows.Backend / mapping: AI output is a proposal with source spans; deterministic approved rules calculate due dates and applicability. Never fabricate service delivery or approvals.
rows.User experience: Ask user to confirm uncertain names, dates and evidence matches.
rows.Acceptance test: A low-confidence expiry date cannot automatically mark someone qualified.

rows.Final behavior: Limit staff to their duties and assigned clients; isolate agency data.
rows.Backend / mapping: Tenant isolation, role/access checks, encryption, MFA, access/audit logs, backups, retention policy and approved vendor configuration. PHI to AI only with applicable BAA and minimum necessary data.
rows.User experience: No sensitive client details in reminder email; secure sign-in opens task.
rows.Acceptance test: Cross-tenant access denied; PHI is excluded from general model prompts and application logs.

rows.Final behavior: Admin oversees rejected evidence, unknown facts, expiring qualifications and requested exceptions.
rows.Backend / mapping: Exception record contains authority, scope, date range, source, approver and attachment. Agency admin cannot waive a DHHS requirement without authority.
rows.User experience: One prioritized review inbox.
rows.Acceptance test: Expired DSPD exception no longer permits affected billing.

rows.Final behavior: Client-specific plans, consent, assignments, service notes, incidents and financial records.
rows.Backend / mapping: Permissions segregate clinical, employment and financial information; staff-client relationship is effective-dated.
rows.User experience: Only relevant tabs and tasks for that client/code.
rows.Acceptance test: PBA financial records are not visible to unrelated DSP staff.

rows.Final behavior: Track licenses, policies, committees, outcomes and site-specific safety duties.
rows.Backend / mapping: Do not turn outcome metrics into individual staff tasks; link metric definitions to actual annual report assignments.
rows.User experience: Admin sees agency and per-location compliance with evidence links.
rows.Acceptance test: A missing site license affects the applicable site/services, not unrelated locations.

rows.Final behavior: Recalculate when role, assignment, client needs, credentials or supervisor change.
rows.Backend / mapping: End relationships; preserve historical evidence; create required access-removal events and replacement coverage issues.
rows.User experience: Admin receives a concise impact list.
rows.Acceptance test: Departing ACRE supervisor triggers reassignment review for their SEI staff.

rows.Final behavior: Export source-linked evidence for selected agency/site/staff/client and time range.
rows.Backend / mapping: Include rule version, source clause, assignment, evidence, acceptance, timestamps, exceptions and amendments. Retention comes from applicable authorities, not a guessed universal period.
rows.User experience: One filtered audit packet.
rows.Acceptance test: Auditor can reconstruct why a person was ready on a past service date.

rows.Final behavior: Grok builds from reviewed mappings; do not load historical Source_index labels as active rules.
rows.Backend / mapping: Implement schema and simulation first. For each published rule require predicates, groups, timing, evidence, source and positive/negative/boundary tests.
rows.User experience: Admin receives proposed change summary before a rule release.
rows.Acceptance test: An unresolved renewal or alternative route prevents automatic activation of that rule.
